settings.selection: first chronological 16-step window with all four owner mode transitions and a mixed step
settings.previous_acceptance: independent of current query; must not exceed the previous published log length
settings.state: one shared compact FP32 base/log per stable owner; no dense transition bridge
settings.initial_state: same saved real-layer accepted state materialized once; no pending log at segment entry
settings.activation_scope: reuse saved real single-layer sites; not original consecutive trajectory activations
settings.candidate: independent Q1/Q4 compact prototype; delayed and ready are matched schedules
settings.native: same actual query widths, installed recurrence/chunk branch; independent continuous dense state
settings.precision: BF16 recurrence operands/output; FP32 compact base/log/products; no new precision scheme
settings.scope: single-layer prototype, not runner integration or service throughput

payload.initial_acceptance_semantics: no pending log: segment-entry accepted metadata does not reapply any old update
